text:
jon_support: Heads up — Nyx Labs trial stuck on onboarding due to ingest schema error, trial seats blocked, customer demo Friday. Flagging renewal-risk. Error snippet: 'schema mismatch: user_id expected string, got object'.

maya_cs: On it. Can you drop workspace id + a minimal failing payload? I'll mobilize enablement.

jon_support: workspace: nyx-342. Repro payload below + SDK version. ```POST /v1/ingest
{
  "user_id": {"id": 123}
}``` Customer on our JS SDK v2.1.0 — fails during validation.

eli_csm: Adding myself. Impact? seats / ARR / demo risk? Need a comms plan if this isn’t <6h.

jon_support: Impact = 5 trial seats + scheduled demo. Customer is blocked from completing onboarding and asked for ETA. High touch account.

maya_cs: Proposed plan: 1) SE triage (sam_se) 2) Hotfix or coercion workaround 3) Draft short customer message 4) Exec alert if >6h. Owners: sam_se (triage/patch), maya_cs (customer comms). Sam — can you take triage?

sam_se: Taking it. Quick check: we can either accept object for user_id in ingest layer or coerce to string on receive. I'll try a temp coercion patch; ETA ~3h.

jon_support: I can open a test branch and push a build. opsbot — can you spin up a staging env for nyx-342?

opsbot: provisioning: test environment <nyx-342-staging> created. Running smoke tests.

sam_se: Pushed branch ingest-coerce-nyx342. Test run accepts payload when we stringify nested id; logs show coercion applied and no validation failure. Can run canary next.

maya_cs: Draft customer note (short):
"Hi — we identified an ingestion validation edge causing your current payloads to fail. We're rolling a targeted fix with ETA ~3 hours. Workaround: run JSON.stringify(user_id) before sending, or use the temporary endpoint we provided. We'll update you as soon as canary is green. — Maya"
Thoughts?

eli_csm: Looks good. Add a rollback sentence and offer to reschedule the demo if needed. I'll prepare a renewal-watch note for the account.

jon_support: I’ll offer the workaround to the customer now and confirm if they'd like the temporary endpoint. Updating thread after canary. :thumbsup:

opsbot: canary-deploy: canary run completed on 2 instances, ingest smoke tests PASS, no regressions detected.

sam_se: Canary green. Merging and scheduling 10% rollout to prod in 15m.

maya_cs: Sending the customer message now and scheduling a +4h follow-up. @eli_csm please add renewal-watch flag and prepare exec note if not resolved by EOD.

eli_csm: Done — renewal-watch flag set on Nyx Labs, check-in scheduled. If unresolved by EOD we'll escalate to AE + CRO.

jon_support: Customer applied the workaround and confirms partial progress; will wait for rollout merge. Thanks team :pray:

maya_cs: Great work everyone. After customer confirms success, I'll post a short retrospective in #enablement and close the loop. Closing this thread once customer confirms ingestion success. - maya
